items.answer: Yes! The entire core game experience is completely free and requires no registration. Just open and play.
items.question: Is it really free?

items.answer: You need internet the first time to load the questions. After that, you can play offline — questions are cached in your browser.
items.question: Do I need an internet connection?

items.answer: Over 500 questions across different categories — from light and fun to deep and intimate. Each mode (couples, family, friends, kids) has unique questions.
items.question: How many questions are there?

items.answer: The Kids mode has specially curated questions — no intimate or adult content. You can safely play with the little ones.
items.question: Is it safe for kids?

items.answer: These are fun challenge cards that appear between questions. You can enable or disable them in settings, and adjust how often they show up.
